differential.name: End‑stage renal disease due to diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: CKD stage 4 with creatinine 2.5 mg/dL, proteinuria, diabetes, obesity and dialysis‑related weight loss indicate advanced diabetic kidney disease awaiting transplant.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Long‑standing essential hypertension and progressive CKD stages 1‑4 are classic for hypertension‑driven renal injury.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia in the setting of CKD stage 4 and reduced erythropoietin production.

differential.name: Secondary hyperlipidemia (diabetes‑related dyslipidemia)
differential.rationale: Elevated total cholesterol (265 mg/dL) and LDL (179 mg/dL) with diabetes and CKD predispose to dyslipidemia.

differential.name: Major depressive disorder / chronic stress secondary to intimate partner abuse
differential.rationale: Recorded stress, intimate partner abuse, unemployment, and pain score 5 suggest significant psychosocial burden contributing to overall health.
